status: Finished within the 60-minute budget. Fixes left in working tree; verification incomplete as listed.

1.cause: The R218 label replaced the Talk action with a plain speaking status even when an answer could be queued. Desktop hover was refreshed only by pointer events, so changing speaker/raycast state could leave a stationary pointer with a stale or empty prompt. The initial isolated prompt probe passed, so the original empty-prompt gate observation was not reproduced there.
1.fix: Talk label follows the actual queue rules: Talk to NAME, Talk to NAME (speaking) when automatic speech can be answered, NAME is busy when an answer is pending/in progress, NAME is listening for the acknowledgement. Refresh the stationary desktop ray/label at most every 120ms; busy status has no misleading Use action. Added a browser check for automatic-speaking → busy → available without moving the mouse.

2.cause: lineValid treated an explicitly requested recording as unsolicited ambient speech. The phone viewport fixture deliberately requests bark.dad.bed2 outside its normal bedtime/computer context, so it was rejected.
2.fix: Public HouseFamily.say requests and context-free scripted speak calls carry an explicit-request flag through enqueue, delivery, save and restore. Player Talk and requested story lines survive ambient rechecks. Automatic seasonal cues with story recording IDs still obey explicit phase guards. Ambient calls with declared context retain delivery-time validation. Remote, telephone, and caption:false calls keep their UI-owned delivery path and shed inherited ambient context. Repeat/once memory remains in place. Bonfire Talk explicitly forwards requested=true; its automatic phase/stage announcements retain their guards.

3.cause: Mom is speaking had no action verb, so the touch control inferred Use and no longer communicated the available Talk action.
3.decision: Keep Talk offered during automatic speech: a player can queue one answer. Once an answer is pending/playing, show busy; touch shows a disabled Wait control plus the status. Gestures show listening.
3.testPolicy: The mobile story action assertion is unchanged; production behavior is fixed to satisfy it.
3.fixDetail: Refresh family status from the cached touch target while preserving the 240/1500 ms world-ray throttling. No repeated raycast is needed to restore Talk after speech.

4.cause: Halloween still consulted the obsolete device-wide jhp_se_said compatibility record, suppressing another account on the same browser.
4.fix: Compatibility reads now use jhp_se_said.<lowercase account>. Ignore the unscoped record because its owner is unknowable; active announcement writes remain in the shared per-account jhp_voice_once.<account> memory. Unit coverage switches between two accounts with a device-wide old record present.
